fields.statement: At e94526667 re-ran the Checks: block: go test -p 2 -trimpath ./internal/run -run 'TestSpawnWake|TestSpawnResume' (PASS, both TestSpawnWake subtests), go test -p 2 -trimpath ./internal/run (ok), go test -p 2 -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'TestRunSpawnWake|TestRunSpawn' (TestRunSpawnWake SaidDone/Exit1 PASS), go vet ./internal/run ./internal/api, rhiza ship generate, rhiza render: all exit 0. Diff read: engine.reconcileSpawns calls the optional SpawnWaker only when AppendSpawnEnded added the entry and the spawn is NoWait, so one wake per child, none for a waiting child, a wake error is only logged; TestSpawnWake covers said-done and exit-1 children across repeated polls and a driver restart, a waiting child waking no one, and an erroring wake logged once with its spawn-ended entry kept. stepRunner.WakeParent closes a said-done child's pane via closeSessionPane and messages the parent (queued while working, typed with a 30s timeout when idle) naming child, role, leaf, outcome, detail and rhiza run status; TestRunSpawnWake checks the pane close, the untouched pane of an exited child, the message file under .rhiza/local/messages/parent-1 and the queued pointer. Only the leaf's four files plus its model log and render changed; no stubs or TODOs.
